In [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]], a '''[[Maladian]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]''' [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Vidar Kim]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] from [[Speeder/Legends|her speeder]]. She then committed [[Death/Legends|suicide]] to avoid [[Prison/Legends|capture]] and [[Torture/Legends|interrogation]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].

==Biography==

===Vidar Kim's assassination===
{{Quote|Who was your target? Myself or the senator? Who hired you?" <br> "Can't... Tell you... Contract..." <br> "You can tell me. You will tell me. You want to tell me." <br> "I want...|Ronhar Kim and the Maladian|<ref name="DP" />}}
In [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]], [[Magister]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]]-secretly the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], Darth Plagueis-required Senator Vidar Kim killed so his apprentice, Senator [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]-secretly the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Darth Sidious-could advance his political career ahead of schedule and take up Kim's position as Senator of Naboo. Vidar-who's family had recently died in a starship crash-was heading for Coruscant to reconnect with his son [[Ronhar Kim]]. Plagueis sent Palpatine over to [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]], having Pestage employ the use of the Maladian Assassins.<ref name="DP" />

A Maladian was sent and instructed to make Vidar's death public. She pulled up behind on a speeder, however, she got arrogant and wished to add Ronhar to her résumé, attempting to kill both. She was successful in killing Vidar, however, Ronhar steered the Maladian off to a pedestrian walkway<ref name="DP" /> and attempted to extract information from her through use of a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]], but the Maladian killed herself by injecting a [[Neurotoxin/Legends|neurotoxin]] into herself.<ref name="R64">[[Republic 64|''Republic'' 64]]</ref>

=== Legacy ===
{{Quote|The Maladian commander I did business with during the Kim affair.” <br> “What of him?” <br> “He contacted me—two, maybe three hours ago. He said that he felt humiliated because of the manner in which the Kim contract had been implemented, and wanted to make it up to me. He said he’d just received word that a Maladian faction had accepted a contract to carry out a major hit on Coruscant, involving someone closely affiliated with Damask Holdings. I feared it might be you." <br> “Who took out the contract?" <br> “Members of the Gran Protectorate.|Sate Pestage and Senator Palpatine|<ref name="DP" />}}
The Maladian's attempt to attack Ronhar and Vidar rather than just Vidar caused the Jedi to conduct an unwanted investigation on the Sith's part. However, with no leads, Sidious and Plagueis were in the clear. The Maladian's sloppy display caused the [[Unidentified Maladian commander|Maladian commander]] to want to make up for the poorly handled assassination. The commander received word that a Maladian faction had taken up a [[Attack on the Lodge of the Canted Circle|contract to kill someone closely related to Damask Holdings]] from the [[Gran Protectorate/Legends|Gran Protectorate]] and informed Pestage of the coming assassination. The commander who did not make clear who the target was caused Pestage to panic making him think Palpatine may have been the target. As it turned out the target was Magister Hego Damask and other members of [[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]]. While the other members perished, Damask fought off the Maladian's with the [[The Force/Legends|Force]], and later had the assistance of Palpatine and Pestage, but the attack left Damask injured and he required a [[Transpirator/Legends|transpirator]] to breath for the rest of his life.<ref name="DP" />

==Personality==
{{Quote|Why didn’t you warn her about Ronhar?” <br> “I did warn her. Maybe she wanted to add another Jedi kill to her résumé.” <br> “Another?” <br> “As I told you, the Maladians are very good at what they do.|Palpatine and Sate Pestage on the Maladian|<ref name="DP" />}}
The Maladian was theorised by Sate Pestage to be arrogant and sought to make the most of her assassinations, willing to claim more targets than requested to simply add another target to her résumé.<ref name="DP" />

==Equipment==
The Maladian wore the attire of the Maladian's and made use of a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and neurotoxin. Additionally, during Vidar Kim's assassination she made use of a speeder.<ref name="R64" />

== Behind the scenes ==
The Maladian first appeared through flashbacks in the [[2004]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]], [[Republic 64|''Republic'' 64]].<ref name="R64" /> It wasn't until [[2012]]'s [[List of books|novel]] ''[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|Darth Plagueis]]'' the Maladian was identified as a Maladian.<ref name="DP" />
